book.name: Marqoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Marqoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusi Kaseti Yootida Xoossa Keeththaa Laaleteth
Izi Xoossa Keeththaafe kezishin iza kaallizaytappe issoy, «Astamaaree! Hayssi keeththaynne keeththay keexettida shuchchay ay mala lo7izaakko hayssa beyay?» gides.
Yesusikka zaaridi, «Hayta gita keeththata xeellay? Shuchchati issoy issaa bolla diza mala deettenna; wurikka laalettana» gides.
Wode Wurseththa Malaatata
Yesusi Xoossa Keeththa ginara Dabrazayte zumaa bolla utti dishin Phexroosi, Yaaqoobey, Yohannisinne Indiraasi xalla izakko shiiqidi,
«Hayssi ayde hananaakko nuus yoota. Hayssi wurseththan polettanaas malatay aazee?» gi oychchida.
Yesusikka isttas, «Oonikka inttena baleththontta mala naagettite.
Buro daroti, ‹Ta Kirstoosa› gishe ta sunththan yaana; darotakka baleththana.
Intte olanne ola wore siyiza wode dagammofte; hessi hananayssi attenna; wurseththi gidikko buroona.
Derey dere bolla, kawoy kawo bolla dendana, daroson biitta qaaththinne koshay hanana; heyti wuri miixas leesso mala.

«Intte inttes naagettite. Buro inttena dere duulatan aaththi immana. Istti inttena Ayhudata Woosa Keeththan garafana. Intte ta markkatta gidana mala ta gishshas dere daannata sinththaninne kawota sinththan eqqana.
Koyrottidi Mishiraachcho qaalay dere ubbaas sabbakettana bessees.
Intte oykettidi pirdas shiiqiza wode hinno he saateyin inttes imettizaaro haasayte attiin biidi, ‹Nu ay giinoo?› giidi kaseti hirgofte; haasayanay Xillo Ayanappe attiin inttena gidekketa.
«Ishay ishaa, aaway ba naa hayqos aaththi immana; nayti bana yelidayta bolla makkallananne wodhana.
Ta gaason intte asa ubbaan ixettidayta gidana; wurseth gakkanaas minni eqqidaadey gidikko attana.
Yerusalaame Bolla Gakkana Gita Meto
«Intte harassiza tunateth izas bessonttason eqqidaashe beykko nababizaadey wozinan woththo; Yuhudan dizayti pude zuma bolla baqatetto.
Keeththa karen dizaadey soo geloppo; ba miish kessana giidi keeththe geloppo.
Goshshason dizaadey ba may7o ekkanaas guye simmofo.
He gallassatan shaara maccassatassinne naa dhanththizaytas aayye ana!
Hessika balgon gidontta mala Xoos woossite.
Xoossi koyro medheteth ubbaa medhdhoosofe ha7i gakkanaas woykko hayssafe guye iza misatizay baynda gita metoy hanana.
Goday he gallassata qaanththonttaako oonikka attenna shin baas doorettidayta gishshas izi he gallassata qaanththides.
«He wode oonikka, ‹Hekko Kirstoosi hayssan dees› giikko woykko, ‹Hekko heen dees› giikko ammanopite.
Wordo Kirstoosatinne wordo nabeti buro dendidi malaatatanne kase hani erontta pala miish ooththana; isttas dandayettiko haray attoshin doorettidaytakka baleththana.
Hessa gishshas naagettite; he wodey gakkontta dishin haara hayssa wursa ta inttes yootadis.
Kirstoosas Nam7anththo Yuus
«He wode he metozappe kaallidi arshey dhumana;
«He wode Asa Nay gita wolqqaranne bonchchora salo shaarara yishin asay iza beyana.
Izikka kiitanchchata yeddidi oyddu baggafe biitta gaxappe gaxa gakkanaas diza baas doorettidayta shiishshana.
Balase Miththay Leemiso
«Leemisoza balase miththafe tamaarte. Unquloy cililiza wode hayth kessishin boney matidayssa intte ereeta.
Hessaththoka hayti ta gidayti polettishin intte beykko wodey mati yiidi penge gakkidayssa erite.
Ta inttes tumu gays; ha yo7oti polettana gakkanaas hayssi ha yeletay aadhdhenna.
Saloynne sa7ay aadhdhana shin ta qaalay gidikko aadhdhenna.
Goday Yaana Gallassayonne Saateyo Oonikka Erenna
«Qasse he gallassay gishshas woykko he saatey gishshas ta Aawappe attiin Salo Kiitanchchata gidiinkka Naaza gidiinkka oonikka erenna.
Hessa gishshas wodey aydekko intte erontta gishshas naagettite, minnitenne woossite.
Hessika ba keeth ashkaratas aggidi ashkarata issaa issaa ooso oyththidi penge naagizayssi beeggidi naagana mala azazidi bida asa misatees.
«Histtiko keeththa aaway ayde yaanaakko woykko leela giddoth yaanaakko woykko koyro kuttoy baqqishin yaanaakko woykko wontta bolla bazzoy zo7ishin yaanaakko intte erontta gishshas beeggidi naagite.
Intte qoppontta dishin izi yiidi intte dhiskidishin inttena demmofo.
«Ta inttes yootizayssa as ubbaas yootays; minnidi naagite! gays» gides.

footnotes.text: Hayssi ha qofay bessizayssi istta deren diza miththati aacizaynne hayththati cililizay bone gididayssa bessanaassa.
